item.title: The God of Detail
item.description: Drawing a parallel between the painstaking craftsmanship of historic French cathedrals and the intentionality of the Creator, this article explores the depth of God’s attention to detail. It serves as a heartening reminder that the same God who designed intricate stained glass also meticulously fashions every aspect of our lives and cares deeply for our smallest concerns.
